     2	# WP-005: Persona Build System Model Resolution Override
     3	
     4	## Plan Context
     5	
     6	Implement configurable model settings for the persona system, replacing hardcoded YAML-only model configuration with a GUI-managed model registry and per-persona model assignment system.
     7	
     8	## Description
     9	
    10	Update the persona build plugin and frontmatter templates to read model assignments from `assignments.json` and `local.json` as the highest-priority override layer in the model resolution chain, and handle the "Inherit / Auto" sentinel correctly for both VS Code and Claude Code frontmatter.
    11	
    12	## Scope
    13	
    14	- `personas/plugins/ledger/index.js` — read assignments at build start, apply override in `onBuildContext` hook
    15	- `personas/plugins/ledger/frontmatter-templates.js` — make VS Code `model` field conditional (`{{#if model}}`)
    16	
    17	## Deliverables
    18	
    19	- At build start (once, cached): read `personas/model-registry/assignments.json` and `personas/model-registry/local.json`; build UUID-to-slug map from `local.json`
    20	- In `onBuildContext` hook: look up `persona_models[persona_id]` UUID in assignments, resolve to slug via UUID-to-slug map, apply as highest-priority override before existing YAML fallback logic
    21	- Resolve `default_model_slug` from `default_model_uuid` in assignments via UUID-to-slug map; override `_shared.yaml` value if found
    22	- `cc_model` resolution: look up resolved model UUID in `local.json` to get its `cc_model` field; fall back to `_shared.yaml` `cc_model` if not found
    23	- "Inherit / Auto" handling: when resolved slug is `"inherit"`, set `model` context variable to falsy (so VS Code frontmatter omits the field); set `cc_model` to `"inherit"`
    24	- VS Code frontmatter template change: `model: '{{model}}'` → `{{#if model}}model: '{{model}}'{{/if}}` — only in VS Code templates; Claude Code templates always render `model:` line
    25	- Graceful fallback: when `assignments.json` and `local.json` don't exist, fall back to current YAML-only behavior
    26	
    27	## Dependencies
    28	
    29	- WP-001
    30	
    31	## Acceptance Criteria
    32	
    33	1. The persona build system resolves models for all three suites using the priority chain: `assignments.json persona_models[persona_id]` > per-persona YAML `model`/`model_slug` > `_shared.yaml` `default_model`/`default_model_slug`
    34	2. `cc_model` is resolved per persona from the registry entry matching the assigned model UUID, falling back to `_shared.yaml` `cc_model`
    35	3. When a persona is assigned the `inherit` model, VS Code frontmatter omits the `model` field entirely
    36	4. When a persona is assigned the `inherit` model, Claude Code frontmatter uses `model: 'inherit'`
    37	5. The build functions correctly when `assignments.json` and `local.json` do not exist (graceful fallback to current YAML-only behavior)
    38	6. The `{{#if model}}` conditional is applied only to VS Code frontmatter templates — Claude Code templates always render their `model:` line
    39	
    40	## Active Pipeline Stages
    41	
    42	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    43	
    44	## Estimated Complexity
    45	
    46	Medium
    47	
    48	## Rationale
    49	
    50	The priority chain preserves YAML as fallback — users who never touch the GUI get the same behavior as today. The GUI is purely additive. UUID-to-slug resolution is performed locally by reading both files — no API dependency.
    51	
    52	## Rejected Approaches
    53	
    54	- *Boolean flag on each assignment `{ slug, inherit: true }`:* A registry entry is simpler — assignments store the sentinel UUID like any other model; consumers check `slug === 'inherit'` after resolution.
    55	- *Separate "no model" dropdown option with no registry entry:* The sentinel entry approach is more uniform — no special-case structure needed.
    56	
    57	## Notes
    58	
    59	Depends on WP-001 (registry files must exist). Can be parallelized with WP-002 through WP-009 (backend/frontend work). The `onBuildContext` hook (L96–L158 in `index.js`) runs for every persona in every suite with no suite guard — it is the single entry point for per-persona model resolution across all suites.
    60	
    61	**Code Observations:** The `onBuildContext` hook in `index.js` (L97–L157) currently handles model fallback at L117–L124: `if (!updated['model'] && updated['default_model'])`. The assignments override must be inserted before this block. The frontmatter templates in `frontmatter-templates.js` (L40–L53 for VS Code, L63–L78 for Claude Code) show that VS Code uses `model: '{{model}}'` (L44) and Claude Code uses `model: '{{cc_model}}'` via the `CC_FRONTMATTER_FIELDS` constant (L28). The `onSuiteInit` hook (L79–L91) conditionally applies ledger frontmatter only when `suite.personaMode === 'numbered'` — for other suites, library/config-level defaults are used. This means the `{{#if model}}` conditional needs to be applied in the config-level templates too (or the builder handles it), not just the ledger template.

1	"""
     2	utils/persona_models.py — Per-stage model slug extractor.
     3	
     4	Reads persona YAML metadata files from ``personas/ledger/src/meta/`` and
     5	returns the API-compatible model identifier for each orchestrator stage.
     6	
     7	Example::
     8	
     9	    slugs = extract_persona_model_slugs(workspace_root)
    10	    # → {"planner": "claude-opus-4-6", "developer": "claude-sonnet-4-6", ...}
    11	"""
    12	
    13	from __future__ import annotations
    14	
    15	import json
    16	import logging
    17	from pathlib import Path
    18	
    19	log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    20	
    21	# Paths relative to workspace root.
    22	_META_DIR_RELATIVE = Path("personas") / "ledger" / "src" / "meta"
    23	_MANIFEST_RELATIVE = Path("shared") / "workflow-manifest.json"
    24	_REGISTRY_DIR_RELATIVE = Path("personas") / "model-registry"
    25	
    26	# Sentinel slug that tells the orchestrator to skip the assignment override.
    27	_INHERIT_SLUG = "inherit"
    28	
    29	
    30	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31	# Internal YAML helpers (stdlib-only — handles only simple scalar fields)
    32	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    33	
    34	def _strip_inline_comment(raw: str) -> str:
    35	    """Remove a YAML inline comment from *raw*, respecting quoted values.
    36	
    37	    Scans *raw* left-to-right.  A ``#`` character that is not enclosed in
    38	    single or double quotes terminates the value; everything from that ``#``
    39	    onward (including surrounding whitespace) is discarded.
    40	    """
    41	    in_quote: str | None = None
    42	    for i, ch in enumerate(raw):
    43	        if ch in ('"', "'"):
    44	            if in_quote is None:
    45	                in_quote = ch
    46	            elif in_quote == ch:
    47	                in_quote = None
    48	        elif ch == "#" and in_quote is None:
    49	            return raw[:i].rstrip()
    50	    return raw
    51	
    52	
    53	def _extract_yaml_scalar(text: str, key: str) -> str | None:
    54	    """Return the top-level scalar value for *key* from simple YAML *text*.
    55	
    56	    Returns ``None`` if the key is absent.  Only top-level ``key: value``
    57	    lines are considered; nested structures, multi-line values, and YAML
    58	    anchors are not supported — the persona metadata files only use simple
    59	    scalars for the fields this module needs.
    60	
    61	    Inline comments and surrounding quotes (single or double) are stripped
    62	    from the returned value.
    63	    """
    64	    prefix = f"{key}:"
    65	    for line in text.splitlines():
    66	        stripped = line.strip()
    67	        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
    68	            continue
    69	        if stripped.startswith(prefix):
    70	            raw = stripped[len(prefix):].strip()
    71	            raw = _strip_inline_comment(raw).strip()
    72	            # Strip surrounding quotes.
    73	            if len(raw) >= 2 and raw[0] in ('"', "'") and raw[-1] == raw[0]:
    74	                raw = raw[1:-1]
    75	            return raw
    76	    return None
    77	
    78	
    79	def _extract_yaml_list(text: str, key: str) -> list[str]:
    80	    """Return the list of simple scalar items under *key* from YAML *text*.
    81	
    82	    Handles the pattern::
    83	
    84	        key:
    85	          - item1
    86	          - item2
    87	
    88	    Returns an empty list if the key is absent or has no list items.
    89	    Only top-level keys are considered.  Items must be simple scalars (not
    90	    nested structures).  Inline comments and surrounding quotes (single or
    91	    double) are stripped from each item.
    92	
    93	    If the key is found but has an inline scalar value (e.g. ``key: value``)
    94	    rather than a block list, an empty list is returned.
    95	    """
    96	    prefix = f"{key}:"
    97	    collecting = False
    98	    result: list[str] = []

   130	# Model-registry helpers (assignments.json / local.json)

   133	def _read_uuid_to_slug_map(workspace_root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
   134	    """Build a UUID → slug map from ``personas/model-registry/local.json``.
   135	
   136	    Returns an empty dict if the file is absent, unreadable, or invalid JSON.
   137	    Entries that lack both ``id`` and ``slug`` fields are silently skipped.
   138	    """
   139	    local_path = workspace_root / _REGISTRY_DIR_RELATIVE / "local.json"
   140	    if not local_path.is_file():
   141	        return {}
   142	    try:
   143	        entries = json.loads(local_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   144	        if not isinstance(entries, list):
   145	            log.debug("local.json is not a JSON array — skipping UUID map build.")
   146	            return {}
   147	        return {
   148	            e["id"]: e["slug"]
   149	            for e in entries
   150	            if isinstance(e, dict) and "id" in e and "slug" in e
   151	        }
   152	    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
   153	        log.debug("Could not read local.json for UUID-to-slug map: %s", exc)
   154	        return {}
   155	
   156	
   157	def _read_assignments(workspace_root: Path) -> dict | None:
   158	    """Read ``personas/model-registry/assignments.json``.
   159	
   160	    Returns the parsed dict on success, or ``None`` if the file is absent,
   161	    unreadable, or does not contain a valid JSON object with the expected shape.
   162	    """
   163	    assignments_path = workspace_root / _REGISTRY_DIR_RELATIVE / "assignments.json"
   164	    if not assignments_path.is_file():
   165	        log.debug("assignments.json not found — using YAML-only model resolution.")
   166	        return None
   167	    try:
   168	        data = json.loads(assignments_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   169	    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
   170	        log.debug("Could not read assignments.json: %s — using YAML-only fallback.", exc)
   171	        return None
   172	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
   173	        log.debug("assignments.json is not a JSON object — using YAML-only fallback.")
   174	        return None
   175	    return data
   176	
   177	
   178	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   179	# Public API
   180	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   181	
   182	def find_ledger_yaml_for_stage(
   183	    stage_id: str,
   184	    workspace_root: Path | str,
   185	) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:
   186	    """Locate the ledger persona YAML file for *stage_id*.
   187	
   188	    Reads ``shared/workflow-manifest.json`` to map *stage_id* to a role
   189	    number, then scans ``personas/ledger/src/meta/`` for the matching file.
   190	
   191	    Returns a ``(yaml_path, yaml_text)`` tuple, or ``None`` if no matching
   192	    file is found or *stage_id* is not in the manifest.
   193	
   194	    Notes
   195	    -----
   196	    The glob pattern ``[1-9]-*.yaml`` only matches files with a **single-digit**
   197	    numeric prefix (i.e. role numbers 1–9).  If a tenth role is ever added with
   198	    a two-digit prefix it will be silently skipped.
   199	    """
   200	    workspace_root = Path(workspace_root)
   201	    meta_dir = workspace_root / _META_DIR_RELATIVE
   202	    manifest_path = workspace_root / _MANIFEST_RELATIVE
   203	
   204	    manifest_data = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   205	    id_to_number: dict[str, int] = {
   206	        r["id"]: r["number"] for r in manifest_data.get("roles", [])
   207	    }
   208	
   209	    target_number = id_to_number.get(stage_id)
   210	    if target_number is None:
   211	        return None
   212	
   213	    for yaml_file in sorted(meta_dir.glob("[1-9]-*.yaml")):
   214	        text = yaml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   215	        number_str = _extract_yaml_scalar(text, "number")
   216	        if number_str is None:
   217	            continue
   218	        try:
   219	            if int(number_str) == target_number:
   220	                return (yaml_file, text)
   221	        except ValueError:
   222	            continue
   223	
   224	    return None
   225	
   226	
   227	def extract_persona_model_slugs(workspace_root: Path | str) -> dict[str, str]:
   228	    """Read persona YAML metadata and return ``{stage_id: model_slug}``.
   229	
   230	    The ``model_slug`` for each stage is resolved via a four-layer priority
   231	    chain:
   232	
   233	    1. ``assignments.json`` ``persona_models[stage_id]`` UUID resolved to a
   234	       slug via ``local.json`` — **skipped** when the resolved slug is
   235	       ``"inherit"`` (the orchestrator always needs a concrete model slug for
   236	       API calls; ``"inherit"`` is an IDE-only sentinel).
   237	    2. Per-persona ``model_slug`` field from the ledger YAML file.
   238	    3. ``assignments.json`` ``default_model_uuid`` resolved to a slug via
   239	       ``local.json`` — **skipped** when the resolved slug is ``"inherit"``.
   240	    4. ``default_model_slug`` from ``_shared.yaml``.
   241	
   242	    When ``assignments.json`` or ``local.json`` are absent or unreadable,
   243	    layers 1 and 3 are silently skipped and resolution falls through to the
   244	    YAML-only layers (identical to the pre-assignments behavior).
   245	
   246	    Parameters
   247	    ----------
   248	    workspace_root:
   249	        Path to the monorepo workspace root.  The metadata directory
   250	        ``personas/ledger/src/meta/``, the shared manifest
   251	        ``shared/workflow-manifest.json``, and the model-registry directory
   252	        ``personas/model-registry/`` are resolved relative to this path.
   253	
   254	    Returns
   255	    -------
   256	    dict[str, str]
   257	        Mapping of stage ID (e.g. ``"developer"``) → API model slug (e.g.
   258	        ``"claude-sonnet-4-6"``).  Contains one entry per role defined in the
   259	        shared workflow manifest that has a matching persona YAML file.
   260	
   261	    Raises
   262	    ------
   263	    OSError
   264	        If the persona metadata directory does not exist.
   265	    FileNotFoundError
   266	        If ``_shared.yaml`` or ``workflow-manifest.json`` is missing.
   267	    ValueError
   268	        If ``default_model_slug`` is absent from ``_shared.yaml``.
   269	
   270	    Notes
   271	    -----
   272	    The glob pattern ``[1-9]-*.yaml`` only matches files with a **single-digit**
   273	    numeric prefix (i.e. role numbers 1–9). If a tenth role is ever added with a
   274	    two-digit prefix (e.g. ``10-new-role.yaml``), it will be **silently skipped**
   275	    by this function. Update the pattern in ``_META_DIR_RELATIVE`` glob call if
   276	    the total number of roles exceeds 9.
   277	    """
   278	    workspace_root = Path(workspace_root)
   279	    meta_dir = workspace_root / _META_DIR_RELATIVE
   280

   283	            f"Persona metadata directory not found: {meta_dir}. "
   284	            "Ensure the workspace is fully checked out."
   285	        )
   286

   288	    # 1. Load default_model_slug from _shared.yaml.
   289	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   290	    shared_path = meta_dir / "_shared.yaml"
   291	    shared_text = shared_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
